mods.name: AcquiredUtils
mods.description: Utility mod with an in-game settings GUI.

releases.notes:
# Features
AcquiredUtils brings a collection of client-side tools designed to make everyday gameplay smoother, cleaner, and more convenient.

## Inventory & Items
* **Inventory & Vault Search** — Quickly find items in inventories and supported vaults.
* **Slot Lock** — Prevent accidental interaction with selected inventory slots.
* **Gear Comparison** — Compare meaningful stats between compatible items.
* **Rarity Highlight** — Highlights item slots according to their rarity.
* **Rarity Glint** — Adds an animated rarity-based glint to held items.
* **Item Position** — Customize the position of held items.
* **Recipe Unlock Highlight** — Easily identify newly unlocked recipes.
* **Inventory Full Warning** — Get notified when your inventory is full.
* **Item Pickup Notifications** — Display useful pickup information.
## HUD & Information
* **Player Profile** — Display your class, active pet, and abilities. -> In progress
* **Health Overlay** — Customizable server-based health display.
* **Mana / Focus Overlay** — Customizable server-based mana display.
* **Configurable Overlays** — Adjust positions and scales to fit your HUD.
## Chat
* **Chat Combination** — Combine consecutive identical messages into a single message with a counter. -> In progress
* **Chat Copying** — Copy the original message without copying the combination counter. -> In progress
* **Custom Keybinds** — Create custom keybinds for commands and automatic messages. -> In progress
## Performance
* **Disable Glowing Effects** — Removes entity glowing effects while avoiding the normal glow rendering work.

readmeSummary: AcquiredUtils is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11. It uses Fabric API and Minecraft's supported client APIs wherever possible, with limited access to Minecraft internals where required...
